_comment: Real, provisioned Kelvran pilot dashboard -- wired via docs/operations/grafana/provisioning/dashboards.yaml, not an example-only file (unlike docs/operations/grafana-cache-dashboard.json). Five panels, each backed by a real, already-shipped gateway/internal/telemetry/telemetry.go metric (kelvran.cache.lookup, kelvran.llm.spend_usd, gen_ai.client.operation.duration's error.type="guardrail_blocked" dimension (see dataplane.go's outcomeFor/errorTypeFor for that one, OUTCOME_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED lowercased), kelvran.fallback.rescued and gen_ai.client.operation.duration's kelvran.fallback.outcome dimension (finalize's fallbackOutcome switch) -- the last two added 2026-10-09 per docs/rfcs/2026-10-09-gateway-fallback-rescued-and-prometheus-pull.md). PromQL uses the OTel-to-Prometheus-native-OTLP-ingestion name translation confirmed live against this pilot's own grafana/otel-lgtm backend (dot -> underscore, '_total' suffix on a monotonic Sum, '_seconds_bucket'/'_sum'/'_count' suffixes on a Histogram) -- verify against your own collector before reusing elsewhere, per grafana-cache-dashboard.json's own identical caveat.
title: Kelvran Gateway Overview

panels.title: Cache hit rate by layer
panels.description: kelvran.cache.lookup, dimensioned by kelvran.cache.lookup_outcome (hit/miss) and kelvran.cache.layer (hit only). See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'Cache lookup hit/miss (metric)' row.

panels.title: Budget burn (real LLM spend, USD/hour)
panels.description: kelvran.llm.spend_usd -- real USD cost of every billable (genuine, unshared) upstream call, per virtual key's real Bedrock spend against its budget_usd cap. See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'LLM spend (metric)' row.

panels.title: Guardrail verdict rate (blocked vs allowed)
panels.description: gen_ai.client.operation.duration, filtered on error.type="guardrail_blocked" -- the low-cardinality error.type value dataplane.go's errorTypeFor emits for GatewayDecisionEvent_OUTCOME_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED (a pre-call or post-call guardrail Block-tier verdict). No dedicated guardrail counter exists yet; this is the real signal available today via the shared GenAI operation-duration histogram's error.type dimension. See docs/rfcs/2026-09-03-guardrails-pii-regex-classifier.md.

panels.title: Fallback rescues per hour, by error class
panels.description: kelvran.fallback.rescued -- requests whose first deployment failed and whose fallback produced the billed response, recorded once per request in dataplane.go's finalize under the same gate it uses for pricing (err == nil || billable). kelvran_fallback_hop_error_class here is the class of the FIRST deployment's failure (content_policy, context_window_exceeded, generic), not of a chain hop. See docs/rfcs/2026-10-09-gateway-fallback-rescued-and-prometheus-pull.md.

panels.title: Fallback rescue ratio (rescued / (rescued + exhausted))
panels.description: gen_ai.client.operation.duration's kelvran.fallback.outcome dimension (none / rescued / exhausted; every chat data point carries it). rescued = a fallback happened and the request was billed; exhausted = a fallback happened and nothing was billed. Requests that never fell back (none) are excluded from both sides, so this is the share of fallback walks that saved the request. See docs/rfcs/2026-10-09-gateway-fallback-rescued-and-prometheus-pull.md.
